units.source_text: 她的书法，从前就很拙陋，现在越发萎缩，竟像刀刻一般生硬。

en.t: Her handwriting had always been very poor, and now it had shrunk even further, becoming stiff and awkward, almost as if carved with a knife.

units.source_text: 源氏看了很不快，觉得恶劣不堪，说道：

en.t: Genji looked at it with great displeasure, thought it was unbearably bad, and said:
She must have taken great pains to compose this poem.

units.source_text: 况且现在侍从之类的侍女已经不在她身边，无人能帮她忙。

en.t: Besides, attendants like Jijū are no longer at her side now, so there is no one who can help her.
One really has to give her credit for it.
He found it amusing, and then went on to say:

units.source_text: “好，我虽然很忙，让我来作答诗吧。”

en.t: Very well, though I am very busy, let me write the reply poem.

units.source_text: 他一面怒气冲冲地写，一面又说：

en.t: As he wrote in a fury, he said again:

units.source_text: “这种怪事，真是别人所意想不到的。

en.t: This sort of strange business is truly something no one else would ever imagine.
In truth, there was absolutely no need for it at all!
